purpose: Define the single progressive-disclosure route for RedCap private knowledge, LLM-wiki-lite, cold archives, and public redcap-arsenal entries.
must_not_claim: The knowledge gateway is not a RAG system.
The gateway must not replace source files as truth sources.
The gateway must not bulk-read private-archive/redcap-knowledge, legacy redcap-knowledge anchors, prism/runs, or public users/** bodies by default.
The gateway must not export private raw reports or identity data into redcap-arsenal.

route_order.body_read_rule: Open exact active knowledge files only after the index identifies them; lesson bodies live under compass/knowledge/lessons/<l-id>.md.
Read metadata first; open entries only for stable concepts, terminology, design philosophy, or repeated failure patterns.
Read public catalog first; open users/<user> entries only after duplicate and relevance checks.
Use inventory and exact path lookups; never sweep the whole archive for live task context.
Open raw evidence only when a report, receipt, or Prism registry points to the exact run.
